title: 第2662章 三百条冰火圣纹第2661章 血渊神龙的震撼
content_zh:
血渊神龙现在心中对林尘的佩服之意，简直如滔滔江水连绵不绝。他活了无尽岁月，见过的天骄如过江之鲫，却从未有一个人能让他生出这般复杂的情绪——既有深深的挫败感，又有难以言喻的欣慰。
他万万没有想到，自己引以为傲的冰火创世诀，在林尘这里修炼起来竟是如此简单，几乎可以用“不费吹灰之力”来形容。林尘不仅将冰火创世诀研究得极为透彻，悟性之高让他钦佩无比，更可怕的是这小子还敢想敢改，硬是将一门古老功法加以改造，使其成为更加贴合自身特点的专属法门。此刻林尘手中的冰火创世诀，威力已达到了极度恐怖的地步。
对此，林尘自然也是心满意足。冰火创世诀能让他的战力百尺竿头更进一步，日后面对那些难缠的对手时，也能更加游刃有余，不必再像以前那样处处仰仗神兵利器。念及至此，林尘的嘴角便勾勒出一抹淡淡的笑意，心情十分愉悦。
此时，叶清霜也来到了林尘身边。她在第三轮考核中的表现同样极为出色，冰天雪地中的那些冰雕对她而言也算不得太大的威胁。因此血渊神龙也给了她相应的奖励，不过并没有传授她冰火创世诀——叶清霜擅长的乃是肉身之道，一身战力全在无双之体上，让她来修炼冰火创世诀，多少有些不合适，反而会分散精力。这门功法交给林尘来学，便是再合适不过，姐弟二人各有所长，互补而不相争。
林尘嘴角扬起一抹灿烂的弧度，继续沉下心神投入到修炼之中。随着时间的推移，他所凝聚出的冰火圣纹也越来越多，手臂上的赤蓝纹路如藤蔓般不断蔓延，散发出古老而沉凝的气息。
而在某个不为人知的阴暗角落中，渊天明的脸色却格外阴沉。他蜷缩在阴影里，捏碎隐身符后的身形与周围的黑暗融为一体，可他的心情却如同被架在火上炙烤，煎熬无比。他原本的如意算盘打得很响——捏碎隐身符藏在暗处，等有人得到机缘宝物露出破绽时，他再突然出手偷袭，坐收渔翁之利。可现实给了他一记响亮的耳光，林尘根本不给他这个机会，从头到尾连一个可乘之隙都没有留下。更让他憋屈的是，血渊神龙设下的考核未免也太难了，他渊天明拼尽全力也未能通过，想要从血渊神龙这里拿到机缘宝物，简直是痴人说梦。
偷袭？他现在连偷袭的资格都没有了。渊天明的心情郁闷到了极点，像是有一团火憋在胸口烧不出去。得知林尘大概率已经得到了血渊神龙的真正传承，他更是怒不可遏，眼底深处掠过一抹彻骨的寒意。且不管光明教高层此前有没有下达针对林尘的命令，即便没有，此刻的他也恨不得将林尘碎尸万段。他心中对林尘的恨意已经深到了骨子里——他好歹是光明教明面上的第一天骄，堂堂教主之子，身份何等尊崇，如今却落得这般狼狈的下场，像只老鼠一样龟缩在阴暗的角落里，连面都不敢露，生怕被林尘发现后顺手给收拾了。这种屈辱感如同一把钝刀，一下一下割着他的自尊。
渊天明虽然清楚林尘的实力有多强横，但他渊天明当然也有自己的过人之处。他嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的弧度，眼眸中有无尽的杀机翻涌而出。渊天明彻底怒了，那股怒火几乎要将他的理智吞没——如果可以的话，他绝不会饶过林尘，绝不会。此刻的渊天明眼底深处尽是寒意，思绪在疯狂运转，一个又一个报复的念头在他脑中闪现又被他否决。
终于，他想到了一种可能。他渊天明身为光明教主之子，身上的底牌远非寻常天骄可比，之前拿出的那些不过是冰山一角罢了。若他全力出手，将那些真正的压箱底手段尽数施展出来，未必就没有把握将林尘彻底镇杀。只是需要一个时机，一个林尘放松警惕的时机。渊天明的眼神变得愈发阴狠，继续隐忍，靠着隐身符龟缩在角落当中，如同一只潜伏在暗处的毒蛇，等待着最佳的出击时刻。
然而渊天明不知道的是，此刻的林尘早已不是之前那个他还能勉强望其项背的对手了。林尘不仅得到了血渊神龙的高度认可，更修炼了真我级别之上的恐怖功法——冰火创世诀。在林尘的不断钻研与改良之下，冰火创世诀已经展现出了令人胆寒的惊人威力。林尘身上凝聚出的冰火圣纹已经达到了三百条，密密麻麻的赤蓝纹路几乎覆盖了他整条手臂，每一道圣纹都蕴含着足以冻结山河又焚尽八荒的冰火融合之力。如今林尘的冰火融合之力已达到了一个相当离谱的地步，一旦毫无保留地宣泄而出，那威力简直堪称毁天灭地。这才是林尘真正的底气所在——不需要神兵利器，不需要花哨的底牌，单凭这三百条冰火圣纹所驱动的冰火融合之力，便足以碾压一切。
血渊神龙本来已经不打算继续给林尘提供资源了。毕竟永恒冰晶和永恒火晶，尤其是这种极高品质的上等货色，每一块都弥足珍贵，他积攒了无尽岁月才有这点家底。一直持续不断地给林尘提供这种高端资源，对他而言无疑也是会心痛的。可架不住林尘软磨硬泡的功夫实在一流，脸皮又厚，嘴皮子又利索，三言两语便又从他这里磨走了一批。如此，林尘在凝聚出三百条冰火圣纹之后，终于收了手，不再继续索要。
血渊神龙也终于长长地松了一口气，那颗悬着的心总算落回了肚子里。还好，自己多少还是留了一点点资源的，没有一股脑儿全部给到林尘。要是真被这小子掏了个底朝天，他估计连肺都要气炸。虽说林尘得到了他的传承，理论上他理应提供相应的修炼资源，但也不能提供这么多啊，这已经不是慷慨了，简直是倾家荡产。
“小子，你以后出去，若是不能将我的冰火创世诀发扬光大，若是不能执掌光明圣城，那我可就跟你没完了。”血渊神龙哼哼唧唧地说道，语气半是威胁半是期许。
“哎，前辈的意思是，以后我若是跟光明教那些个老登起了冲突，前辈会出来为我护道？”林尘嘿嘿一笑，顺着杆子就往上爬。他心中盘算得很清楚——血渊神龙的实力绝对是极为恐怖的，纵然如今只剩意志化身，那也是一尊不容小觑的顶尖战力。如果血渊神龙愿意出来为他护道，那么他拿下整个光明圣城的过程自然会轻松许多，至少不用时时刻刻担心被那些老东西暗中算计。
“这个……恐怕不行。”血渊神龙想了想，还是果断地摇了摇头，龙脸上露出一抹为难之色。
林尘并未在意，脸上的笑意反而更深了几分。他不急不缓地伸出手，掌心中光华一闪，一柄通体流转着圣洁光芒的长枪凭空而现，枪身上古老的符文如呼吸般明灭不定，散发出一股令人心悸的威严气息。林尘缓缓将光明圣枪横于身前，语气淡然却带着一抹笃定：“如果说，我有这件东西呢？”
看到光明圣枪的瞬间，血渊神龙的瞳孔骤然急剧收缩，那张龙脸上的表情在短短一息之间经历了好几次剧烈变化——从疑惑到震惊，再到无以复加的惊骇。
他的眼珠子都快要掉下来了，龙嘴微微张开却一个字也说不出来。他万万没有想到，林尘手中竟然会有此物。光明圣枪，这可是光明圣城城主继承人的象征，是光明圣城自创立之初便代代相传的至高信物。
林尘拥有光明圣枪，意味着他本就是名正言顺的光明圣城未来主人，这座城邦的权柄本来就该归属于他。
血渊神龙好不容易才从震惊中回过神来，心中掀起的惊涛骇浪却久久无法平息。林尘一见面就给他掏出了如此珍贵的重宝，此物的价值简直无法用语言来形容。谁都知道光明圣枪意义非凡，手握光明圣枪的林尘，毫无疑问就应该执掌整个光明圣城。日后光明圣城的天下，本来也应当归属林尘。而他血渊神龙受故友之托守护光明圣城的基业，为手持光明圣枪的未来城主效力，自然也是情理之中的事。

不过血渊神龙还是没有急着答应。他沉默了片刻，缓缓开口说道：“我与光明教，多少还算有些交情。如果你要跟光明教彻底开战的话，念在过去那份旧情的份上，我确实很难帮你去对付他们。不过我可以答应你的是——若是光明教的那些人对你不利，若是有朝一日你遇到了性命之忧，我必然会出手相助。这是我欠故友的，也是我欠你的。”
血渊神龙面色凝重地做出了承诺，语气中没有半分敷衍。
“有前辈这句话就够了。”林尘微微一笑，并不强求更多。血渊神龙战力强悍，纵然只是一道意志化身也足以震慑群雄，有他作为林尘的坚实后盾，危急关头至少多了一张保命的底牌。这笔买卖怎么算都不亏。
血渊神龙此刻也是愈发庆幸自己遇到了林尘。他将冰火创世诀交到林尘手里，绝对是再合适不过的选择了，这个年轻人身上有着一种让人不得不信服的特质。血渊神龙眼中浮现出一抹灿烂的光芒，话锋一转，语气中多了几分迫不及待：“对了，我的冰火创世诀，如今你修炼得如何了？让我亲眼看看你冰火创世诀的威力。”
“好。”林尘当然不会拒绝，他也正想试试自己修炼的成果究竟达到了何种地步。
血渊神龙不再多言，浑身气息骤然爆发，一股磅礴如渊的龙威如同实质般向四周碾压开来，整座神殿都在他的威压下微微震颤。他一爪挥出，龙爪撕裂虚空，裹挟着毁天灭地般的力量朝林尘当头罩下。面对血渊神龙这强横无匹的攻势，林尘同样不甘示弱，心念一动，体内三百条冰火圣纹同时亮起，赤蓝交织的光芒将他整个人映照得如同降世神魔。他掌心之中，一朵冰火创世莲迅速凝聚成形，那朵莲花不过巴掌大小，却仿佛蕴含着足以创造万物、亦可毁灭万物的恐怖力量，在三百条冰火圣纹的全力加持之下，携带着无与伦比的毁灭气息横空杀出。
冰火创世莲与龙爪在虚空中轰然相撞，刹那间爆发出刺目的光芒。冰与火的力量在碰撞点疯狂交织、湮灭、再爆发，那朵冰火创世莲仿佛有着无可比拟的逆天神威，仅仅一朵却爆发出湮灭一切、破碎一切的恐怖破坏力。在冰火创世莲的滔天神威之下，强如血渊神龙的意志化身都被震得连连后退，龙影在虚空中晃了几晃才勉强稳住身形。
此刻血渊神龙的脸上终于浮现出了一抹极度的凝重之色，随即又化为难以掩饰的狂喜。冰火融合之力一直是他引以为傲的底蕴所在，是他纵横天地无尽岁月的最强依仗。而如今，他的看家本领在林尘手中施展出来，威力竟丝毫不逊于他当年巅峰之时，甚至在林尘的改良之下更添了几分凌厉与霸道。林尘的战力让血渊神龙真正意识到了什么叫做绝世妖孽，什么叫做盖世无双。对于林尘所展现出的天赋，他已无话可说，唯有由衷的叹服。
“好！好！好！”血渊神龙连说三个好字，龙瞳中闪烁着激动的光芒，“我将传承交给你，总算没有白费，我也可以放心了。其实我的寿元也并没有剩下多少，在彻底坐化之际能亲眼见证一位绝世天骄的诞生，能将毕生所学托付给你，我很欣慰，也很满足。”
血渊神龙缓缓开口说着，语气中带着一种看透生死、心愿已了的释然，看向林尘的目光中满是欣赏与期许。无尽岁月的等待，无数天骄的筛选，终于在这一刻画上了圆满的句号。
“前辈可还有什么未了的心愿吗？”林尘抱了抱拳，神色恭敬地问道。在血渊神龙这里，他得到的好处实在太多了——真我龙骨助他龙血突破，血渊龙火为他淬体炼魄，冰火创世诀更是给了他一张足以横行天下的底牌。投桃报李，照例询问血渊神龙是否还有未了的心愿，这也是理所应当的。如果能够做到，林尘一定会竭尽全力帮血渊神龙达成。
“唯愿你执掌光明圣城之后，能够尽快让光明圣城恢复往日的荣光。”血渊神龙的目光变得悠远而深沉，仿佛穿透了神殿的穹顶，望向了那片他曾经征战过的广袤天地，“你要知道，光明圣城存在的意义从来不是争权夺利，而是征战诡异一族。如今那些后辈子弟不去对付那些令人作呕的诡异族，只知内斗倾轧，这算什么回事？”
“前辈放心，我说过会去收拾那些诡异族的，自然不会食言。”林尘微微一笑，语气平静却坚定。就算血渊神龙不说，他也不会放过那些令人作呕的诡异族，这既是承诺，也是他作为光明圣枪持有者不可推卸的责任。
如今林尘已将冰火创世诀修炼到了精深奥妙的地步，三百条冰火圣纹加身，一朵冰火创世莲可破万法。血渊秘境的历练至此也接近了尾声。这次历练本就是光明教所提供的一次机缘，也是万宗盛会用来考核天骄的核心环节。谁能在血渊秘境中得到最多的血渊令，谁便是本次万宗盛会的最终胜者，这一点毋庸置疑。而此刻，林尘身上正散发出一股强横无匹的气息，那是他此行所有收获的外在彰显——龙血已臻真我神龙之境，冰火创世诀大成，三百条冰火圣纹尽数凝练。整个血渊秘境中，再没有第二个人能与林尘争锋。万宗盛会的冠军归属，在这一刻已毫无悬念。

content_en:
The admiration for Lin Chen that Blood Abyss Divine Dragon felt in his heart was like an endless stream of water. He has lived for endless years and has seen many talented people like crucian carp crossing the river, but no one has ever made him have such complicated emotions - a deep sense of frustration and indescribable relief.
He never expected that the Ice and Fire Creation Technique that he was so proud of would be so easy to practice here in Lin Chen. It could almost be described as "effortless". Not only did Lin Chen study the Ice and Fire Creation Technique extremely thoroughly, and his high level of understanding made him admire him immensely, but what was even more frightening was that this kid also dared to think and change, and just transformed an ancient technique into an exclusive technique that better suited his own characteristics. At this moment, the power of the Ice and Fire Creation Technique in Lin Chen's hand had reached an extremely terrifying level.
Lin Chen was naturally satisfied with this. The Ice and Fire Creation Technique can make his combat prowess a step further. When facing difficult opponents in the future, he will be more able to deal with them with ease, and he will no longer have to rely on magical weapons like before. Thinking of this, a faint smile appeared on the corner of Lin Chen's mouth, and he felt very happy.
At this time, Ye Qingshuang also came to Lin Chen. Her performance in the third round of assessment was also extremely good, and the ice sculptures in the ice and snow were not a big threat to her. Therefore, the Blood Abyss Divine Dragon also gave her corresponding rewards, but it did not teach her the Ice and Fire Creation Technique - Ye Qingshuang was good at the physical way, and all her combat power was in her unparalleled body. It was somewhat inappropriate for her to practice the Ice and Fire Creation Technique, and it would distract her energy. It was perfect for Lin Chen to learn this skill. The two siblings had their own strengths and complemented each other rather than competing with each other.
The corner of Lin Chen's mouth raised a bright arc, and he continued to concentrate on practicing. As time went by, he condensed more and more ice and fire sacred patterns, and the red and blue patterns on his arms continued to spread like vines, exuding an ancient and condensed aura.
But in some unknown dark corner, Yuan Tianming's face was particularly gloomy. He huddled in the shadows, and after crushing the invisibility talisman, his figure merged with the surrounding darkness, but his mood was as if he was being roasted on a fire, extremely tormenting. His original plan was very good - crush the invisibility charm and hide it in the dark. When someone gets the chance treasure and exposes a flaw, he will suddenly make a sneak attack and reap the benefits. But reality gave him a loud slap in the face. Lin Chen didn't give him this chance at all, leaving not even a single opportunity to take advantage of from beginning to end. What made him even more frustrated was that the test set by the Blood Abyss Dragon was too difficult. He, Yuan Tianming, tried his best but failed to pass. It was simply a fantasy to get the chance treasure from the Blood Abyss Dragon.
Sneak attack? Now he is not even qualified for a sneak attack. Yuan Tianming's mood was extremely depressed, as if there was a fire in his chest that couldn't be burned out. Knowing that Lin Chen had most likely obtained the true inheritance of the Blood Abyss Dragon, he was even more furious, and a bone-chilling chill passed through his eyes. Regardless of whether the higher-ups of the Guangming Cult had issued orders against Lin Chen before, even if they had not, at this moment he wanted to cut Lin Chen into pieces. The hatred for Lin Chen in his heart was deep in his heart - after all, he was the most arrogant person in the Guangming Sect and the son of the dignified leader. His status was so esteemed, but now he ended up in such an embarrassing end, huddled in a dark corner like a mouse, not even daring to show his face, for fear that Lin Chen would find out and take care of him. This feeling of humiliation was like a dull knife, cutting into his self-esteem.
Although Yuan Tianming knew how powerful Lin Chen was, of course he, Yuan Tianming, also had his own strengths. The corners of his mouth curved into a cold arc, and endless murderous intent surged out of his eyes. Yuan Tianming was completely angry, and the anger almost swallowed up his reason - if he could, he would never spare LinDust, never. At this moment, Yuan Tianming's eyes were filled with chills, his thoughts were running wildly, and one idea of ​​revenge flashed in his mind but was rejected by him.
Finally, he thought of a possibility. As the son of the leader of the Guangming Cult, Yuan Tianming's trump cards were far from ordinary geniuses, and those he had shown before were just the tip of the iceberg. If he goes all out and uses all the real tricks to suppress the situation, he may not be sure to completely kill Lin Chen. It just takes a chance, a chance for Lin Chen to relax his vigilance. Yuan Tianming's eyes became more sinister, and he continued to hold back, huddled in the corner with the invisibility charm, like a poisonous snake lurking in the dark, waiting for the best moment to strike.
However, what Yuan Tianming didn't know was that Lin Chen at this moment was no longer the opponent he could barely hold a candle to before. This was Lin Chen's true confidence - he didn't need magic weapons or fancy trump cards. The fusion power of ice and fire driven by these three hundred ice and fire sacred patterns alone was enough to crush everything.
Blood Abyss Dragon had no intention of continuing to provide resources to Lin Chen. After all, eternal ice crystals and eternal fire crystals, especially these extremely high-quality goods, each piece is extremely precious. He has accumulated this wealth for endless years. He was thick-skinned and sharp-tongued. With just a few words, he was able to win away a lot of people from him. In this way, after Lin Chen condensed three hundred ice and fire holy patterns, he finally stopped and stopped asking for it.
The Blood Abyss Dragon finally breathed a long sigh of relief, and his hanging heart finally fell back into his stomach. Fortunately, I still had some resources left over, and I didn't give them all to Lin Chen. If he was really ripped out by this kid, his lungs would probably explode with anger. "Boy, if you can't carry forward my Ice and Fire Creation Technique when you go out in the future, if you can't take charge of the Holy City of Light, then I will never be done with you." The Blood Abyss Dragon grunted, his tone half threatening and half hopeful.

Lin Chen didn't pay attention, but the smile on his face became a little deeper. He stretched out his hand unhurriedly, and with a flash of light in his palm, a spear with holy light flowing throughout its body appeared out of thin air. Lin Chen's possession of the Holy Spear of Light means that he is the legitimate future master of the Holy City of Light, and the authority of this city-state should belong to him.

Lin Chen, who held the Holy Spear of Light, should undoubtedly be in charge of the entire Holy City of Light. In the future, the world of Guangming Holy City should also belong to Lin Chen. It is natural that he, the Blood Abyss Dragon, is entrusted by his old friend to protect the foundation of the Holy City of Light and serve the future city lord who holds the Holy Spear of Light.

But what I can promise you is - if those people from the Guangming Sect are not good for you, if one day you are in danger of your life, I will definitely help. This is what I owe my old friend, and I owe you."
The Blood Abyss Dragon made the promise with a solemn expression, and there was no hint of perfunctoriness in his tone.
"Senior's words are enough." Lin Chen smiled slightly and did not insist on more. The Blood Abyss Dragon was so powerful that even just an incarnation of his will was enough to intimidate the heroes. With him as Lin Chen's solid backing, he at least had one more life-saving trump card at a critical moment. This deal is not a loss no matter how you calculate it.
Blood Abyss Dragon was now even more grateful that he had met Lin Chen. It was definitely the most suitable choice for him to hand the Ice and Fire Creation Technique into Lin Chen's hands. This young man had a quality that made people believe in him. A bright light appeared in the eyes of the Blood Abyss Dragon. He changed the topic and said with a bit more impatient tone: "By the way, my Ice and Fire Creation Art, how are you practicing now? A majestic abyss-like dragon power crushed all around like a substance, and the entire temple trembled slightly under his pressure. He swung out his claws, and the dragon claws tore through the void, shrouding Lin Chen's head with a power that could destroy the world. Under the full blessing of three hundred ice and fire holy lines, it shot out across the sky with an unparalleled aura of destruction.

The power of ice and fire intertwined wildly at the collision point, annihilated, and exploded again. The Ice and Fire Creation Lotus seemed to have incomparable power.The imitation of heaven-defying divine power, just one flower burst out with terrifying destructive power that annihilated everything and shattered everything. Under the overwhelming divine power of the Ice and Fire Creation Lotus, the incarnation of the will as powerful as the Blood Abyss Divine Dragon was shocked and retreated repeatedly. The dragon's shadow swayed in the void for a few times before it barely stabilized its figure.
At this moment, a look of extreme solemnity finally appeared on the face of the Blood Abyss Dragon, and then it turned into unconcealable ecstasy. The power of the fusion of ice and fire has always been his proud heritage, and it has been his strongest support for endless years of conquering the world. But now, his special skills are being used in Lin Chen's hands, and his power is no less powerful than when he was at his peak. It has even become more fierce and domineering due to Lin Chen's improvements. Lin Chen's fighting prowess made Blood Abyss Dragon truly realize what it means to be a peerless monster and what it means to be unparalleled. He had nothing to say about Lin Chen's talent, he could only express his sincere admiration.
"Okay! Okay! Okay!" Blood Abyss Divine Dragon said three good words in a row, and the eyes of the dragon were flashing with excitement. "I will hand over the inheritance to you. It has not been in vain, and I can rest assured. In fact, I don't have much life left. When I am completely dead, I can witness the birth of a peerless talent with my own eyes. I can entrust you with what I have learned throughout my life. I am very happy and satisfied."
The Blood Abyss Dragon spoke slowly, with a kind of relief in his tone that he had seen through life and death and that his wish was over. His eyes looking at Lin Chen were full of appreciation and expectation. The endless years of waiting and the screening of countless geniuses finally came to a successful end at this moment.
"Senior, do you have any unfulfilled wishes?" Lin Chen asked respectfully, clasping his fists. From the Blood Abyss Divine Dragon, he got so many benefits - the True Self Dragon Bone helped him break through with dragon blood, the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire tempered his body and soul, and the Ice and Fire Creation Technique gave him a trump card that could dominate the world. It is only natural to reciprocate a favor and ask the Blood Abyss Divine Dragon if he has any unfulfilled wishes. If he can do it, Lin Chen will definitely do his best to help the Blood Abyss Dragon achieve it.
"I only hope that after you take charge of the Holy City of Light, you can restore the Holy City of Light to its former glory as soon as possible." "You have to know that the meaning of the existence of the Holy City of Light has never been to fight for power, but to fight against the weird clan. Now those younger generations don't deal with those disgusting weird clan, and only know about internal fighting. What's going on?"
"Senior, don't worry. I said I would deal with those weird tribes, so I won't break my promise." Lin Chen smiled slightly, his tone calm but firm. Even if the Blood Abyss Dragon doesn't say anything, he will not let go of those disgusting weird tribes. This is both a promise and an unshirkable responsibility for him as the holder of the Holy Spear of Light.
Now Lin Chen has practiced the Ice and Fire Creation Technique to a profound and profound level. With three hundred ice and fire sacred patterns added to his body, one Ice and Fire Creation Lotus can defeat all kinds of magic. The experience of the Blood Abyss Secret Realm is now coming to an end. This experience was originally an opportunity provided by the Guangming Sect, and it was also the core link used by the Ten Thousand Sects Festival to assess the geniuses. At this moment, Lin Chen was exuding an unparalleled aura, which was the external manifestation of all the gains he had made during this trip - the dragon blood had reached the realm of the true self, the divine dragon, the Ice and Fire Creation Technique was completed, and all three hundred ice and fire holy patterns were condensed.
